summary.name: Novita AI
summary.one_liner: Novita AI is a cloud platform offering model APIs for 200+ AI models, GPU infrastructure (instances and serverless GPUs), and agent runtimes under one API.
use_cases: Calling hosted AI models through one API
Scaling from API calls to dedicated GPU clusters
Building AI agents on managed runtimes
Running image, text-to-speech or LLM inference workloads
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Novita AI as a platform combining Model APIs (200+ models), custom model deployment, GPU Instances, and Serverless GPUs. Users can call models through a unified API, rent on-demand GPUs, and run secure agent runtimes. It states the platform can scale from APIs to dedicated clusters. The page claims up to 50% lower price-performance cost than major cloud providers and low-latency, high-throughput uptime, but gives no specific benchmarks. A directory listing describes it as an AI image generation service.
notable: 200+ hosted models accessible through one unified API
Model APIs, GPU infrastructure, and agent runtimes on a single platform
Claims up to 50% less cost than major cloud providers
Scales from serverless APIs to dedicated GPU clusters
caveats: Page says 'Free to start' but does not detail paid tier limits or prices
Cost savings claim ('up to 50%') is unquantified marketing language without benchmarks
